sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日商业与政策通讯《DealBook》的报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，与商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖进行现场对话，其中包括 J·D

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、最真实的对话。

sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 nytimes.com 上直播精选访谈，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月免费畅读我们所有新闻的权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你会收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: After years of false start, the United States has signed a historic peace deal with the Taliban to end the war in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 经过多年的几经波折，美国与塔利班签署了一项具有历史意义的和解协议，以结束阿富汗战争。

sentences.en: My colleague, Mujib Mashal, traveled to the front lines in Afghanistan and the signing ceremony in Doha to find out whether peace is actually possible.
sentences.zh: 我的同事穆吉卜·马沙尔前往阿富汗前线以及在多哈的签字仪式，去探寻和平是否真的可能实现。

sentences.en: It's Friday, March
sentences.zh: 今天是3月

sentences.en: 6th.
sentences.zh: 6日，星期五。

sentences.en: Mujib, what was the situation heading into this peace deal?
sentences.zh: 穆吉卜，在迎来这项和平协议之前，当时的局势是怎样的？

sentences.en: This conflict has gone on for about 40 years.
sentences.zh: 这场冲突已经持续了大约40年。

sentences.en: It kind of began with the Soviet invasion in the 70s and it dragged on.
sentences.zh: 它有点像是从70年代苏联入侵开始的，然后一直拖延下去。

sentences.en: It became a civil war and the chaos of the civil war became a safe haven for terrorist groups like al-Qaeda that use it as, you know, launching grounds to attack the United States.
sentences.zh: 它演变成了一场内战，而内战的混乱为基地组织等恐怖分子提供了庇护所，他们利用这里作为发动袭击美国的基地。

sentences.en: And in retaliation, the United States invaded Afghanistan and they toppled the
sentences.zh: 作为报复，美国入侵了阿富汗，并且推翻了

sentences.en: Taliban government that was hosting al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 庇护基地组织的塔利班政府。

sentences.en: So now we've got mostly three main players.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们基本上有三个主要参战方。

sentences.en: One is the Taliban that feels that they are a government in waiting because they were toppled.
sentences.zh: 一个是塔利班，他们觉得自己是候任政府，因为他们曾被推翻。

sentences.en: And then it's the U.S.
sentences.zh: 然后是美国

sentences.en: military that's been on the ground for 18 years and they want out.
sentences.zh: 军队，他们在当地已经驻扎了18年，现在他们想要撤出。

sentences.en: And so that's the second player.
sentences.zh: 这就是第二方。

sentences.en: And the third player is the Afghan government that has been propped up by the United States over the past 18 years.
sentences.zh: 第三方是在过去18年里一直得到美国支持的阿富汗政府。

sentences.en: And they are in the middle because they haven't been part of the negotiations.
sentences.zh: 他们处在中间，因为他们没有参与谈判。

sentences.en: So the effort to find a way out that can satisfy all the three players, it's been a difficult process.
sentences.zh: 因此，寻找一条能够满足这三方要求的出路，是一个艰难的过程。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Mujib, the last time you and I spoke, a peace deal was on the brink of happening.
sentences.zh: 而且，穆吉卜，上一次你和我交谈时，和平协议正处于千钧一发之际。

sentences.en: But the Taliban carried out an attack.
sentences.zh: 但塔利班发动了一次袭击。

sentences.en: It killed an American.
sentences.zh: 造成了一名美国人死亡。

sentences.en: President Trump, who was involved in those negotiations, was furious and at the last minute called the talks off.
sentences.zh: 参与这些谈判的特朗普总统勃然大怒，并在最后一刻取消了会谈。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But that process was picked up again in recent months.
sentences.zh: 但这一进程在最近几个月又重新启动了。

sentences.en: And in the past few weeks, it finally felt like it was seriously coming together that we may have a way out of this conflict.
sentences.zh: 在过去几周里，人们终于感觉到它正在认真地朝着终点迈进，我们也许有了一条摆脱这场冲突的出路。

sentences.en: The way it happened is that they took the same deal that they almost finalized last September.
sentences.zh: 事情的经过是，他们拿出了去年9月差点最终敲定的同一份协议。

sentences.en: They put a condition in front of it.
sentences.zh: 并在其前提下附加了一个条件。

sentences.en: The condition was that for seven days across Afghanistan, the violence level needed to be significantly reduced just to build some truSt. So ordinary Afghans
sentences.zh: 这个条件是，在阿富汗全国范围内，暴力水平必须连续七天大幅降低，以此来建立一些信任，让普通阿富汗人

sentences.en: could finally get to imagine what the evidence of peace could look like.
sentences.zh: 终于能够开始想象和平的迹象究竟是什么样的。

sentences.en: And when that temporary truth started, the first thing that came to my mind was, what does it mean to the soldiers who've been fighting for years with no respite?
sentences.zh: 当那个临时停火开始时，我脑海中浮现的第一件事是，对于那些年复一年战斗、毫无喘息之机的士兵来说，这意味着什么？

sentences.en: So I thought of this guy I had sat next to on one of my flights, earlier flights from southern Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 于是我想到了我在之前从阿富汗南部飞回的航班上，坐在我旁边的那个人。

sentences.en: I sat next to this guy and I started making small talk with him and he was like, yeah, I'm a highway police commander posted in this stretch of highway
sentences.zh: 我坐在他旁边，开始和他闲聊，他说，是的，我是扎布尔省和坎大哈省之间这段高速公路上的公路警察指挥官，这两个地方都是战争中遭受重创的地区。

sentences.en: between Zabul and Kandahar provinces, both very, very badly hit areas of the war.
sentences.zh: 扎布尔省和坎大哈省之间这段高速公路上的公路警察指挥官，这两个地方都是战争中遭受重创的地区。

sentences.en: And I was like, hey, would it be okay for me to come visit you at some point?
sentences.zh: 我说，嘿，我改天去拜访你，可以吗？

sentences.en: He was like, sure.
sentences.zh: 他说，当然可以。

sentences.en: So I got his number and we were always nervous to go visit a place like that for security reasons.
sentences.zh: 所以我拿到了他的电话号码，处于安全考虑，去那种地方总是让人感到紧张。

sentences.en: So when this truce went into effect, the first person that came to my mind was him.
sentences.zh: 所以当这个停火协议生效时，我脑海中浮现的第一个人就是他。

sentences.en: I want to go see what does it feel like for these guys who have constantly faced loss and fire to go see, engage their emotions and
sentences.zh: 我想去看看，对于这些时刻面临伤亡和炮火的人来说，去体会和释放他们的情绪是一种怎样的感受，

sentences.en: how they were experiencing this very rare breather from daily violence and daily attacks.
sentences.zh: 以及他们是如何体验这来之不易、可以从日常暴力和袭击中获得喘息的机会的。

sentences.en: So what did you do?
sentences.zh: 所以你做了什么？

sentences.en: So photographer Kiana Hayri and I, we flew to Kandahar.
sentences.zh: 我和摄影师基亚娜·海里飞往了坎大哈。

sentences.en: And from there, we found this old, really seasoned taxi driver who had done the road for about 40 years.
sentences.zh: 在那里，我们找到了一个老练的、经验丰富的老出租车司机，他在这条路上跑了大约40年。

sentences.en: And he drove us to the commander, to the base on the highway.
sentences.zh: 他开车送我们去见指挥官，去高速公路上的基地。

sentences.en: And it's a beautiful drive, but every couple miles of the drive getting to this commander was seeing bridges blown up, the road blown up.
sentences.zh: 沿途的风景很美，但在去见这位指挥官的路上，每隔几英里就能看到被炸毁的桥梁和道路。

sentences.en: So we arrived at this outpost on top of a hill.
sentences.zh: 于是我们抵达了山顶上的这个前哨站。

sentences.en: And we're met by the commander.
sentences.zh: 指挥官出来迎接我们。

sentences.en: And he sort of oversees this 40, 50 mile stretch of the highway.
sentences.zh: 他负责巡视这片长达40、50英里的高速公路。

sentences.en: The one good thing he has is good weather, you know.
sentences.zh: 他拥有的一件好事就是天气不错。

sentences.en: He's got about 300 men spread out in a dozen outposts.
sentences.zh: 他手下大约有300名士兵，分散在十几个前哨站。

sentences.en: Because what the Taliban do is plant a bomb.
sentences.zh: 因为塔利班的做法是埋下一颗炸弹。

sentences.en: When a convoy is driving, they blow up the bomb.
sentences.zh: 当车队驶过时，他们引爆炸弹。

sentences.en: And then once the convoy sort of gets disoriented with the explosion, they attack them from all corners.
sentences.zh: 一旦车队因爆炸而陷入混乱，他们就会从四面八方发起袭击。

sentences.en: This is the main way the Taliban come here.
sentences.zh: 这是塔利班来到这里的主要方式。

sentences.en: So every morning, they come out and they just patrol along the highway, look for any wires, look for any pieces of the asphalt dug up.
sentences.zh: 所以每天早晨，他们都会出来沿着高速公路巡逻，寻找任何电线，寻找沥青路面被刨开的痕迹。

sentences.en: This is what they get the mines.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们寻找地雷的方法。

sentences.en: The actual mine or the cables?
sentences.zh: 真正的地雷还是连接线？

sentences.en: The cables, that's how they dig it up.
sentences.zh: 连接线，他们就是这样把线挖出来的。

sentences.en: This is what they dig the cable with.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们用来挖掘电线的工具。

sentences.en: And this commander, something that really, really got to me in the sense of how bad they've been suffering,
sentences.zh: 这位指挥官所说的话深深触动了我，让我感受到了他们遭受了多么深重的苦难，

sentences.en: was he was like, listen, I've lost more men fetching water than I have in face-to-face fighting.
sentences.zh: 他说，听着，我手下因为去打水而伤亡的人数，比正面交锋中阵亡的还要多。

sentences.en: My men come out and they make their way down to get water in these buckets.
sentences.zh: 我的手下出来，提着这些水桶走下去打水。

sentences.en: And a sniper takes them out.
sentences.zh: 然后狙击手就干掉了他们。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So that's how badly they've been surrounded.
sentences.zh: 所以他们被包围得就是这么严密。

sentences.en: That's the kind of fire they were receiving.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们所遭受的炮火袭击。

sentences.en: And I asked him, I was like, how has it been this couple of days of...
sentences.zh: 我问他，我说，这几天的情况怎么样……

sentences.en: We visited them on day three, I think, of this violence reduction.
sentences.zh: 我们拜访他们的时候，我想已经是减少暴力行动的第三天了。

sentences.en: And he's like, it's been beautiful.
sentences.zh: 他说，感觉太美妙了。

sentences.en: These are the latest ideas they put out.
sentences.zh: 这些是他们提出的最新想法。

sentences.en: These are the latest ideas they put out.
sentences.zh: 这些是他们提出的最新想法。

sentences.en: I was like, is that thing still packed?
sentences.zh: 我说，那东西还在装填吗？

sentences.en: He's like, yeah, if I push it right now, I'm like, please don't.
sentences.zh: 他说，对啊，如果我现在按下它，我说，求你别按。

sentences.en: Seeing them walk around, seeing them just, some of them having their weapons down.
sentences.zh: 看着他们四处走动，看着他们，其中有些人把武器放了下来。

sentences.en: He's just been engaged three days ago.
sentences.zh: 他才刚刚参战三天。

sentences.en: It felt like they were, you know, breathing a little relief.
sentences.zh: 感觉他们好像，你知道，稍微喘了一口气。

sentences.en: And then he said, let's go for a drive.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我们去兜风吧。

sentences.en: You good?
sentences.zh: 你还好吗？

sentences.en: And he was showing us a couple of other outposts.
sentences.zh: 他带我们去看其他几个前哨站。

sentences.en: Like, from the 300 people he has, he probably doesn't have a single one who hasn't been wounded at some point during the war.
sentences.zh: 在他手下的300人中，可能没有一个人在战争期间没有受过伤。

sentences.en: And the amazing part was, a lot of his fighters were really young, 20, 22, 23, 25.
sentences.zh: 令人惊奇的是，他的很多战士都很年轻，20岁、22岁、23岁、25岁。

sentences.en: A lot of them had started as child soldiers, you know, 14, 15-year-olds.
sentences.zh: 他们中的很多人很小就当了娃娃兵，你知道，14、15岁。

sentences.en: And many of them were really badly broken.
sentences.zh: 而且他们当中有许多人身体残缺得十分严重。

sentences.en: Somebody was missing a finger, somebody was missing a leg, somebody was missing an eye.
sentences.zh: 有人少了一根手指，有人少了一条腿，有人少了一只眼睛。

sentences.en: Some were wounded two, three times by the time they're 24, 25 now.
sentences.zh: 有些人现在才24、25岁就已经负伤两三次了。

sentences.en: Let's see.
sentences.zh: 让我看看。

sentences.en: There were these two brothers, actually three brothers.
sentences.zh: 这里有两兄弟，其实是三兄弟。

sentences.en: One was home, had already lost a leg.
sentences.zh: 其中一个在家，已经失去了一条腿。

sentences.en: Their father had served in the police for a long time, and he'd just died last year clearing roadside bombs.
sentences.zh: 他们的父亲曾在警察部队服役很长时间，去年在清除路边炸弹时刚刚牺牲。

sentences.en: So that job had been passed down to the sons.
sentences.zh: 所以这份工作便传给了他的儿子们。

sentences.en: And both of them were in their early 20s.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都刚出头二十岁。

sentences.en: One was, I think, 21, the other was 23.
sentences.zh: 一个我想是21岁，另一个是23岁。

sentences.en: And one of them, his only interaction with the Taliban was when he was detained by them for three days and tortured.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人，他与塔利班唯一的交集就是曾被他们拘押了三天并遭到酷刑折磨。

sentences.en: And he still has the scars of that torture to show.
sentences.zh: 至今他身上还留着那些酷刑的伤疤。

sentences.en: The village they come from in a different neighboring province, it is entirely contested by the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 他们来自另一个邻省的村庄，那里完全被塔利班所控制。

sentences.en: So these brothers can't really go home often.
sentences.zh: 所以这两兄弟实际上无法经常回家。

sentences.en: One of them actually even arrived late to his own wedding because his family had prepared, you know, all the festivities.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人甚至因为家人已经准备好了所有的庆祝活动，而他却迟到了自己的婚礼。

sentences.en: He tried to find the truck driver that could, you know, smuggle him to his own village for the wedding.
sentences.zh: 他试图找到能把他偷运回自己村庄参加婚礼的卡车司机。

sentences.en: By the time he got there, the festivities were over, you know, so he missed his own wedding, basically.
sentences.zh: 等他赶到时，庆祝活动已经结束了，所以基本上他错过了自己的婚礼。

sentences.en: They were so young and they're so shaped by this war that when I asked them even basic questions of what peace could mean to them,
sentences.zh: 他们年纪轻轻，却被这场战争深深地塑造了，以至于当我问他们关于和平对他们意味着什么这样最基础的问题时，

sentences.en: they would just, you know, smile and, you know, this grin and they couldn't mentally get into the details of it.
sentences.zh: 他们只是，你知道，微微一笑，露出那种笑容，在精神上无法深入细节。

sentences.en: So I pushed him, I was like, listen, peace means the 50,000, 60,000 Taliban fighters out there either laying down their arms or integrating into the army and the police
sentences.zh: 所以我追问他，我说，听着，和平意味着外面的那五六万名塔利班武装分子要么放下武器，要么融入军队和警察队伍，

sentences.en: and basically sitting across from you sharing this barrack with you.
sentences.zh: 并且基本上就坐在你对面，与你共用这个营房。

sentences.en: And one of them was like, I don't like them.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人说，我不喜欢他们。

sentences.en: I don't like the way they look.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌他们的样子。

sentences.en: And I was like, well, that's what peace means.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，这就是和平的含义。

sentences.en: It means those Taliban fighters who need to be accommodated somehow.
sentences.zh: 这意味着那些塔利班武装分子需要以某种方式被接纳。

sentences.en: So he thought about it again, and he's like, well, peace is good, but we'll think about it.
sentences.zh: 于是他再次思考了一下，说道，嗯，和平是件好事，但我们会考虑的。

sentences.en: The commander is just 29 years old, but he seemed so sort of seasoned and so experienced and so wise.
sentences.zh: 这位指挥官只有29岁，但他看起来显得如此成熟、经验丰富且充满智慧。

sentences.en: And he got a little more reflective as we were driving between outposts.
sentences.zh: 当我们驱车前往不同的前哨站时，他变得更有沉思感了。

sentences.en: And one of the stories he told us as we were driving was as an example of what pains him about this war.
sentences.zh: 在开车途中，他给我们讲了一个故事，作为他痛恨这场战争原因的一个例子。

sentences.en: And he said, listen, I wish I was fighting people who were from a different country.
sentences.zh: 他说，听着，我希望我是在和不同国家的人打仗。

sentences.en: The people who were fighting, they're not even from a different village, they're not even from a different district.
sentences.zh: 而我们正在与之战斗的人，甚至都不是来自不同的村庄，甚至都不是来自不同的区。

sentences.en: And he told us the story of this local guy who he said had come to his outpost for tea and for lunch with other elders maybe even a dozen times.
sentences.zh: 他给我们讲了当地一个人的故事，他说这个人可能已经有十几次来到他的前哨站，和长老们一起喝茶、吃午饭。

sentences.en: And then they discovered him planting roadside bombs during one of their operations.
sentences.zh: 然后他们在一次行动中发现这个人正在埋设路边炸弹。

sentences.en: And he didn't even know the guy was a Taliban.
sentences.zh: 他甚至都不知道这家伙是个塔利班。

sentences.en: To him, that was a point of how localized, how interlinked and interwoven this conflict is.
sentences.zh: 对他而言，这恰恰说明了这场冲突是多么的本土化、多么的盘根错节、密不可分。

sentences.en: It almost seems that the easier part of the peace is between the Taliban and the Americans.
sentences.zh: 似乎和平中比较容易的一部分是塔利班与美国人之间。

sentences.en: But we're talking about peace between people who are sharing the same stretch of the highway.
sentences.zh: 但我们谈论的是那些分享同一段高速公路的人之间的和平。

sentences.en: And sharing tea, in fact.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们还一起喝茶。

sentences.en: Who are sharing tea.
sentences.zh: 他们还一起喝茶。

sentences.en: And he said the most basic thing, the most important thing in human life is freedom.
sentences.zh: 他说，人权中最基础、最重要的事情就是自由。

sentences.en: And he said, life is nothing without freedom.
sentences.zh: 他说，没有自由，生命便毫无意义。

sentences.en: And he said, the way we live, you know, these targets on our back, wherever we travel, constant fear of attacks and violence.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们这种生活方式，你知道的，背后仿佛有着靶子，无论去哪里，都时刻笼罩在遭受袭击和暴力的恐惧之中。

sentences.en: He said, this is not life.
sentences.zh: 他说，这根本不叫生活。

sentences.en: You know, this is not life.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这根本不叫生活。

sentences.en: As I was with them and hearing their stories, it was very clear that the truce was working.
sentences.zh: 当我与他们在一起并倾听他们的故事时，很明显，停火正在发挥作用。

sentences.en: They hadn't faced any fire in several days.
sentences.zh: 他们已经好几天没有遭到炮火袭击了。

sentences.en: And the truce working meant the peace deal would go ahead and be signed between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 停火发挥作用意味着和平协议将得以推进，并在多哈由美国和塔利班正式签署。

sentences.en: and the Taliban in Doha.
sentences.zh: 并在多哈由美国和塔利班正式签署。

sentences.en: So we got back in our taxi, drove to Kandahar.
sentences.zh: 于是我们坐回出租车，开往坎大哈。

sentences.en: We took a flight from Kandahar to Kabul.
sentences.zh: 我们搭乘航班从坎大哈飞往喀布尔。

sentences.en: I spent the night in Kabul and then from there, fly to Doha to make it in time for the signing.
sentences.zh: 我在喀布尔过夜，然后从那里飞往多哈，以便及时赶上签字仪式。

sentences.en: It's the day before the agreement is supposed to be signed.
sentences.zh: 今天是协议预计签署的前一天。

sentences.en: And the dignitaries are arriving from around the world.
sentences.zh: 来自世界各地的政要们正在陆续抵达。

sentences.en: Sheraton, Doha.
sentences.zh: 多哈喜来登酒店。

sentences.en: It seems like it's happening.
sentences.zh: 这一切似乎真的要发生了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: They're putting final touches at the venue.
sentences.zh: 他们正在会场进行最后的收尾工作。

sentences.en: So, Mujib, you are in Doha, getting ready to report on this historic peace agreement.
sentences.zh: 穆吉布，你在多哈，正准备报道这项具有历史意义的和平协议。

sentences.en: What is the scene like there?
sentences.zh: 那里的场景是怎样的？

sentences.en: So, the event is supposed to happen at the Sheraton in Doha.
sentences.zh: 活动预计在多哈的喜来登酒店举行。

sentences.en: There's a podium where the signing is going to happen and two sides are going to give speeches.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个将要进行签字的讲台，双方将发表讲话。

sentences.en: And this ballroom is prepared.
sentences.zh: 这个宴会厅已经准备好了。

sentences.en: Kind of spotless red carpet.
sentences.zh: 一尘不染的红地毯。

sentences.en: And the red sort of velvety drapings behind the platform.
sentences.zh: 平台后面悬挂着红色的天鹅绒帷幕。

sentences.en: And it says, the agreement for bringing peace to Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 上面写着：为阿富汗带来和平的协议。

sentences.en: And people are slowly trickling in to find their way.
sentences.zh: 人们正陆陆续续地走进来寻找座位。

sentences.en: The most high-profile guest is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 最高级别的嘉宾是美国

sentences.en: Secretary of State, Mike Pompeo, and the emir of Qatar.
sentences.zh: 国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥和卡塔尔埃米尔。

sentences.en: And then, dozens of Taliban started arriving for the occasion.
sentences.zh: 接着，数十名塔利班成员开始为这一场合陆续抵达。

sentences.en: A lot of more unusual noise and clamor than you would see at a normal diplomatic event.
sentences.zh: 比你在普通外交活动中看到的要热闹和嘈杂得多。

sentences.en: And because this wasn't a normal diplomatic event.
sentences.zh: 因为这不是一次普通的外交活动。

sentences.en: It was an insurgency that was only known for blowing stuff up and fighting in the battlefield.
sentences.zh: 这是一个只因炸毁东西和在战场上战斗而闻名的反叛武装。

sentences.en: And now, sitting in the same room as the Secretary of State and, you know, world leaders and getting ready to sign as equals with a world power.
sentences.zh: 而现在，他们与国务卿以及世界领导人坐在同一个房间里，准备以平等的身份与世界大国签字。

sentences.en: The ceremony just gets in the way.
sentences.zh: 仪式反倒成了走过场。

sentences.en: All the dignitaries have arrived.
sentences.zh: 所有政要都已抵达。

sentences.en: And then, as the proceeding started, I found a seat on the balcony upstairs.
sentences.zh: 随后，随着议程开始，我在楼上的阳台上找到了一个座位。

sentences.en: And Secretary of State Pompeo gets up and he gives brief remarks.
sentences.zh: 国务卿蓬佩奥起身发表了简短讲话。

sentences.en: This effort only became real for the United States when the Taliban signaled interest in pursuing peace and ending their relationship with al-Qaeda and other foreign terrorist groups.
sentences.zh: 只有当塔利班表示有兴趣追求和平并结束与基地组织及其他外国恐怖组织的关系统时，美国才认为这一努力成为现实。

sentences.en: The agreement that we will sign today is the true test of this effort.
sentences.zh: 我们今天将要签署的协议，就是对这一努力的真正考验。

sentences.en: So, Mujib, what's actually in the agreement that's about to be signed?
sentences.zh: 那么，穆吉布，即将签署的协议里究竟包含什么内容？

sentences.en: The most concrete thing in the agreement is an American commitment to start withdrawing the remaining of its troops.
sentences.zh: 协议中最具实质性的内容是美国承诺开始撤出其剩余部队。

sentences.en: So, right now, there are still about 12,000 American troops in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 目前，阿富汗境内仍有大约12,000名美军。

sentences.en: And the agreement lays out a 14-month timeline for a gradual withdrawal of those troops.
sentences.zh: 协议为这些军队的逐渐撤离制定了14个月的时间表。

sentences.en: Here's our take on what steps by the Taliban will make this agreement a success.
sentences.zh: 以下是我们对塔利班采取哪些步骤才能使该协议取得成功的看法。

sentences.en: There is some basic language of conditionality attached to it.
sentences.zh: 其中附带了一些关于条件的基本表述。

sentences.en: First, keep your promises to cut ties with al-Qaeda and other terrorists.
sentences.zh: 首先，履行你切断与基地组织及其他恐怖分子联系的承诺。

sentences.en: Keep up the fight to defeat ISIS.
sentences.zh: 继续战斗以击败伊斯兰国。

sentences.en: That in return, the Taliban are making some commitments that they would not allow terror groups, they'll not allow al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 作为回报，塔利班做出了一些承诺，即他们不允许恐怖组织存在，也不允许基地组织存在。

sentences.en: The other pieces are that the Americans will help release up to 5,000 of the Taliban prisoners who are in the Afghan government.
sentences.zh: 其他内容是，美国将协助释放阿富汗政府关押的多达5,000名塔利班囚犯。

sentences.en: And those prisoners will get released in the next couple of weeks before the Taliban sit down for direct negotiations with the other Afghan side.
sentences.zh: 这些囚犯将在未来几周内获释，之后塔利班才会坐下来与阿富汗另一方进行直接谈判。

sentences.en: And start the difficult conversations on a political roadmap for your country.
sentences.zh: 并开始就你国家的政治路线图展开艰难的对话。

sentences.en: And then in that future negotiations, at the top of the agenda, there would be a comprehensive ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 在未来的谈判中，议程的首要任务将是全面停火。

sentences.en: And for all of us here, and most importantly, for the security of the American Afghan people, this must happen.
sentences.zh: 为了这里的我们所有人，最重要的是，为了美国和阿富汗人民的安全，这必须发生。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And then the Taliban's deputy gets up.
sentences.zh: 然后塔利班的副领导人起身。

sentences.en: He seems nervous and he's struggling to read the text.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很紧张，念起稿子来有些吃力。

sentences.en: But he basically says the same thing, that we want a peaceful future.
sentences.zh: 但他基本上表达了同样的意思，即我们渴望和平的未来。

sentences.en: We are committed to the agreement that we'll sign.
sentences.zh: 我们致力于签署的协议。

sentences.en: There was muted cries of Allahu Akbar from the Taliban guys, which is sort of a victory cry.
sentences.zh: 塔利班人员中传出了低声的“真主至大”呼喊声，这算是一种胜利的欢呼。

sentences.en: And then the deputy Taliban leader takes his place at the desk.
sentences.zh: 接着，塔利班副领导人在书桌前就座。

sentences.en: And the American chief negotiator takes a seat next to him.
sentences.zh: 美国首席谈判代表在他旁边坐下。

sentences.en: And the Taliban guy, he's watching closely to make sure the American envoy puts his signature down first, as if to make sure there isn't some sort of a last minute trick.
sentences.zh: 塔利班的那个人仔细看着，确保美国特使首先签字，仿佛是为了确认不会有什么最后一刻的把戏。

sentences.en: And after the American signs the first page, the Taliban opens his pen and he starts signing also.
sentences.zh: 在美国人在第一页上签字后，塔利班打开钢笔也开始签字。

sentences.en: And that was it.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样成了。

sentences.en: They had signed an agreement that had taken a year and a half of negotiations.
sentences.zh: 他们签署了一项经过一年半谈判才达成的协议。

sentences.en: And there was a sense of expectation that this momentous signing between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 人们有一种期待感，认为美国与塔利班之间这一具有重大意义的签字将为和平开辟道路。

sentences.en: and the Taliban would open the way for peace.
sentences.zh: 但就在双方签字后，塔利班又开始发动袭击了。

sentences.en: But as soon as the two sides signed, the Taliban have started attacking again.
sentences.zh: 现在，还记得周末美国与塔利班之间那个具有里程碑意义的协议吗？

sentences.en: Now, remember that landmark deal between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 好吧，协议现在开始出现裂痕了。

sentences.en: and the Taliban at the weekend?
sentences.zh: 似乎正在瓦解。

sentences.en: Well, cracks are now starting to appear in the agreement.
sentences.zh: 签署仅四天就已经开始瓦解了。

sentences.en: Appears to be unraveling.
sentences.zh: 就在美国与塔利班达成具有里程碑意义的停战协议几天后，阿富汗爆发了新的暴力冲突。

sentences.en: It's already unraveling just four days after it was signed.
sentences.zh: 回到塔利班对阿富汗前哨基地发动袭击的状态。

sentences.en: New violence in Afghanistan just days after that landmark truce between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 回到塔利班在公路上拦截行人的状态。

sentences.en: Back to Taliban launching attacks on Afghan outposts.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗警方称，早些时候至少已有三人丧生。

sentences.en: Back to Taliban stopping people on the highways.
sentences.zh: 此后每天都有数十人死亡。

sentences.en: Afghan police say that at least three people have been killed earlier.
sentences.zh: 分离主义分子的袭击已造成至少19人死亡。

sentences.en: Dozens dead every day since.
sentences.zh: 20名阿富汗士兵。

sentences.en: Separatist attacks have left at least 19 people.
sentences.zh: 超过20名阿富汗士兵。

sentences.en: 20 Afghan soldiers.
sentences.zh: 身亡。

sentences.en: More than 20 Afghan soldiers.
sentences.zh: 33起袭击发生在……

sentences.en: Dead.
sentences.zh: 本周早些时候，国防部长马克·埃斯珀警告称，阿富汗的暴力冲突将持续下去。

sentences.en: 33 attacks in...
sentences.zh: 蒙吉，为什么塔利班会在签署和平协议几天、甚至几小时后就开始发动袭击？

sentences.en: Earlier this week, Defense Secretary Mark Esper warned violence will continue in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 好吧，塔利班表示，该协议明确他们的暴力行为只针对美国人结束。

sentences.en: Munji, why would the Taliban begin launching attacks days, hours after signing a peace deal?
sentences.zh: 协议中没有关于减少对阿富汗政府、对阿富汗安全部队袭击的内容。

sentences.en: Well, the Taliban say the deal makes it clear their violence is only ending with the Americans.
sentences.zh: 我曾把这个问题抛给塔利班。

sentences.en: And there's nothing in the deal about reducing attacks on Afghan government, on Afghan security forces.
sentences.zh: 我说，听着，18、19年来，你们一直说这是一场针对外国人的圣战，对吧？

sentences.en: And I've posed this question to the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 但外国人刚刚和你们签了字。

sentences.en: And I was like, listen, so for 18, 19 years, you've been saying this is a jihad against foreigners, right?
sentences.zh: 他们要离开了。

sentences.en: But the foreigners just signed with you.
sentences.zh: 那你们现在怎么能把流淌的阿富汗人的血正当化呢？

sentences.en: They're leaving.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So how do you legitimize the shedding of Afghan blood now?
sentences.zh: 而他的反应是，等等，等等，等等，等等，等等，慢着，慢着。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我们让外国人同意离开，并不意味着我们现在就能放弃他们所创建的结构、

sentences.en: And he was like, wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, hold on, hold on.
sentences.zh: 他们扶植的政府、他们建立的系统，让他们继承一切。

sentences.en: Just because we got the foreigners to agree to leave, doesn't mean we can give up already that the structure they created,
sentences.zh: 而我们却被晾在一边，不去纠正喀布尔那个未能纳入我们愿望的系统。

sentences.en: the government they propped up, the system they put in place, will inherit everything.
sentences.zh: 所以他们非常明确，他们将继续把暴力作为争取政治变革的筹码。

sentences.en: And we will be left out here without correcting that system that is in Kabul to include our wishes also.
sentences.zh: 因此在他们看来，他们需要继续对这些美国权力的延伸和投射发动战争。

sentences.en: So they're very clear that they're going to continue to use violence as leverage to bring political change also.
sentences.zh: 根据这项协议，他们被允许这样做，因为协议只明确规定不能攻击美军。

sentences.en: So in their mind, they need to keep waging a war on these kind of extensions and projections of American power.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And they are allowed to do it under this agreement because it only explicitly says you cannot attack the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以在周三，也就是连续三天暴力冲突之后，发生了一件有趣的事。

sentences.en: forces.
sentences.zh: 一旦美军重新开始行动，他们就对塔利班发动了空袭。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 美军的理由是，听着，协议可能刚刚明确结束了我们之间的暴力，

sentences.en: So there's an interesting thing that happened just on Wednesday after three days of violence.
sentences.zh: 也就是塔利班与美国人之间，但协议中有一种精神，即如果你们突然开始攻击阿富汗安全部队，作为美军，我们保留前去保护他们的权利。

sentences.en: Once the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是和平协议中一个非常重大的结构性缺陷，留下了如此多的模糊空间，

sentences.en: military got back into action, they carried out an airstrike against the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 以至于你昔日的敌人可以继续摧毁美国在那里建立的政府。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这里确实存在结构性缺陷，当然。

sentences.en: military's justification was, listen, the agreement may have just ended the violence explicitly between us,
sentences.zh: 但在绕过这个结构性缺陷时，有两种可能性。

sentences.en: meaning between the Taliban and the Americans, but there's a sense in the agreement that if you all of a sudden start attacking the Afghan security forces, we as the U.S.
sentences.zh: 一种是通过让敌人同意停火来确保这种情况不会发生，对吧？

sentences.en: military reserve the right to go to their defense.
sentences.zh: 塔利班绝不可能同意停火。

sentences.en: That feels like a very significant structural flaw in a peace deal to have left so much ambiguity
sentences.zh: 所以你要么继续谈判几个月试图迫使他们停火，

sentences.en: that your former enemy can go on to destroy the government that the United States has built there.
sentences.zh: 要么他们同意了这个存在结构性缺陷的协议，

sentences.en: There's a structural flaw in that, sure.
sentences.zh: 但希望由于美国保留了空袭的权利，这意味着塔利班会减少袭击，以免冒着被美军空袭消灭的风险。

sentences.en: But getting around that structural flaw, there were two possibilities.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在看到的是，塔利班正在试探在美国将保护阿富汗政府到什么程度这一模糊地带，他们能做到哪一步。

sentences.en: One was you can ensure that doesn't happen by getting the enemy to agree to a ceasefire, right?
sentences.zh: 但他们也在试探别的东西。

sentences.en: The Taliban in no way were going to agree to a ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 作为协议的一部分，美国承诺协助释放5,000名塔利班囚犯。

sentences.en: So you either kept negotiating for months to try to force them to a ceasefire,
sentences.zh: 而阿富汗政府说，没门。

sentences.en: or they have agreed to this structurally flawed agreement,
sentences.zh: 那是我们的囚犯。

sentences.en: but hoping that because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国无权承诺这样的事情。

sentences.en: reserves the right to carry out airstrikes, would mean the Taliban will carry out fewer attacks to risk being killed by American airstrikes.
sentences.zh: 而塔利班现在则表示，我们不在乎。

sentences.en: So what we're seeing right now is the Taliban testing how much they can get away with in this ambiguous area of how far the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国，你们自己解决。

sentences.en: will go to defend the Afghan government.
sentences.zh: 你们向我们作出了承诺。

sentences.en: But they're also testing something else.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，这感觉就像他们正在利用暴力来提醒阿富汗政府，如果他们在囚犯问题上拖延，

sentences.en: So as part of the deal, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 塔利班在战场上依然是个现实的存在。

sentences.en: has committed to helping release 5,000 of the Taliban prisoners.
sentences.zh: 而且他们依然拥有同样的火力。

sentences.en: And the Afghan government said, no way.
sentences.zh: 乌吉布，我想知道你是否和你在签字前拜访过的那些警官交谈过。

sentences.en: Those are our prisoners.
sentences.zh: 乌吉布，我谈过。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 我是说，重新联系上他们有点费劲，因为他们执勤的那个地区，塔利班的做法是切断手机信号塔，

sentences.en: doesn't have the right to commit to something like that.
sentences.zh: 然后你就失去了手机信号。

sentences.en: And the Taliban now are like, we don't care.
sentences.zh: 但当我重新联系上他们时，

sentences.en: U.S., you sort it out.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们在过去连续三个晚上都遭到炮火袭击。

sentences.en: You committed to us.
sentences.zh: 他们向我们展示并带我参观的一个前哨基地里，有两个人受伤了。

sentences.en: But at the same time, it almost feels like they're using violence to remind the Afghan government that if they drag their foot on the prisoner's issue,
sentences.zh: 我们去拜访的那位指挥官遭到了伏击。

sentences.en: the Taliban are still a reality in the battlefield.
sentences.zh: 所以指挥官说，对我们来说，袭击又回到了从前的水平。

sentences.en: But they still have the same sort of firepower.
sentences.zh: 但他讲了一件非常有趣的事，我认为这总结了塔利班最近袭击事件发生后的情绪。

sentences.en: Ujib, I wonder if you've talked to those police officers that you had visited before the signing.
sentences.zh: 他说，但他们的袭击现在有一个好处，那就是让事情变得清晰了。

sentences.en: Ujib, I did.
sentences.zh: 这让我们的战斗变得清晰了。

sentences.en: I mean, it was a bit of a struggle to get back in touch with them because that area where they're serving, what the Taliban do is they cut off cell towers
sentences.zh: 直到现在，塔利班还在说，哦，外国人在这里，我们在与外国人战斗。

sentences.en: and you lose cell phone signal.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上给了他们的战斗一点合法性，对吧？

sentences.en: But when I got back in touch with them,
sentences.zh: 他说，现在他们已经和外国人达成了协议，却仍然决定攻击我们，我们更有理由还击了，

sentences.en: they said they've been facing fire for the past three consecutive nights.
sentences.zh: 因为他们的袭击已经不再具备那种合法性了。

sentences.en: One of the outposts they showed us and I toured, they had two people wounded in that outpoSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这在一定程度上让他们看清了这场战斗。

sentences.en: Their commander that we went to see, he was ambushed.
sentences.zh: 但他们在签字后每天的现实与签字前的现实毫无二致，这让他们感到沉重，

sentences.en: So the commander is like, it's back to the same levels of attack for us.
sentences.zh: 他们回到了老样子，你知道的，遭到射击然后进行还击。

sentences.en: But he said something really interesting that I think summed up the mood after the recent Taliban attacks.
sentences.zh: 感觉这个和平协议对他们来说一点也不像和平。

sentences.en: He said, but one thing that is good about their attacks now is that it makes things clear.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这只是战争新阶段的开始。

sentences.en: It makes our fight clear.
sentences.zh: 目前来看，确实不像。

sentences.en: That until now, the Taliban were saying, oh, the foreigners are here, we're fighting the foreigners.
sentences.zh: 这实际上感觉像是他们已经在进行的战争的延续。

sentences.en: And that kind of give their fight a little legitimacy, right?
sentences.zh: 但这让我们的战斗变得清晰了。

sentences.en: And he said, now that they've gotten their agreement with the foreigners and they're still deciding to attack us, we have a more open hand to return fire
sentences.zh: 直到现在，塔利班还在说，哦，外国人在这里，我们在与外国人战斗。

sentences.en: as their attacks don't have that same legitimacy anymore.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上给了他们的战斗一点合法性，对吧？

sentences.en: So it's almost crystallized the fight for them a little bit.
sentences.zh: 他说，现在他们已经和外国人达成了协议，却仍然决定攻击我们，我们更有理由还击了。

sentences.en: But the fact that their daily reality after the signing has been no different from their reality before the signing
sentences.zh: 因为他们的袭击已经不再具备那种合法性了。

sentences.en: seemed heavy on them, that they were back to the same, you know, being shot at and returning fire.
sentences.zh: 所以这在一定程度上让他们看清了这场战斗。

sentences.en: It feels like nothing about this peace deal actually looks like peace to them.
sentences.zh: 但他们在签字后每天的现实与签字前的现实毫无二致，这让他们感到沉重。

sentences.en: In fact, it's just the beginning of a new phase of the war.
sentences.zh: 他们回到了老样子，你知道的，遭到射击然后进行还击。

sentences.en: At the moment, it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 感觉这个和平协议对他们来说一点也不像和平。

sentences.en: It actually feels like a continuation of the war they're fighting already.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这只是战争新阶段的开始。

sentences.en: But one thing that came out of this peace deal was a brief pause,
sentences.zh: 但这项和平协议带来的一个成果是短暂的停火，

sentences.en: even if it was just for seven days.
sentences.zh: 哪怕只有短短七天。

sentences.en: They felt and experienced a new reality.
sentences.zh: 他们感受并体验到了崭新的现实。

sentences.en: And maybe, maybe for a long time they won't experience that again.
sentences.zh: 也许，也许在很长一段时间里，他们都不会再经历这一切了。

sentences.en: Maybe their reality will be violence.
sentences.zh: 也许他们的现实仍将是暴力。

sentences.en: But at least they have a reference point now.
sentences.zh: 但至少他们现在有了一个参考点。

sentences.en: They can think back to seven days and maybe that will serve as a reminder of what is still possible and what they can still get to.
sentences.zh: 他们可以回想起那七天，也许那会成为一种提醒，提醒他们什么仍然是可能的，他们还能去向何方。

sentences.en: Majib, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 马吉布，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: Italy and Iran have ordered all schools and universities to close as the coronavirus sweeps across both countries.
sentences.zh: 随着冠状病毒席卷两国，意大利和伊朗已下令关闭所有学校和大学。

sentences.en: In Italy, around 150 people have died from the virus, the highest number outside of China.
sentences.zh: 在意大利，大约已有150人死于该病毒，这是中国以外最高的数字。

sentences.en: While in Iran, there are now more than
sentences.zh: 而在伊朗，目前已有超过

sentences.en: 3,500 infections.
sentences.zh: 3500起感染病例。

sentences.en: In the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 在美国，

sentences.en: California has declared a state of emergency after an outbreak that has infected dozens of residents.
sentences.zh: 在发生了一场感染数十名居民的疫情后，加利福尼亚州已宣布进入紧急状态。

sentences.en: And state officials said they were ordering a cruise ship to remain off the coast of San Francisco out of fear that the coronavirus may be spreading among its passengers.
sentences.zh: 州官员表示，由于担心冠状病毒可能在乘客中传播，他们正下令一艘游轮停留在旧金山海岸外。

sentences.en: As of Wednesday evening, there were at least
sentences.zh: 截至周三晚间，美国至少有

sentences.en: 211 infections in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 211起感染病例。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: I will not be running for president in 2020, but I guarantee I will stay in the fight for the hardworking folks across this country who have gotten short end of the stick
sentences.zh: 我将不会参加2020年总统竞选，但我向你们保证，我会继续为这个国家那些一再吃亏、饱受不公的勤劳民众而战。

sentences.en: over and over.
sentences.zh: 一遍又一遍。

sentences.en: That's been the fight of my life, and it will continue to be so.
sentences.zh: 那是我一生都在为之奋斗的事业，而且以后也还会继续。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren dropped out of the Democratic race for president on Thursday, saying that after a series of disappointing primaries, there was no longer a place for her
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦于周四宣布退出民主党总统候选人提名竞选，称在经历了系列令人失望的初选后，这场竞选中

sentences.en: in the race.
sentences.zh: 已经没有她的立足之地了。

sentences.en: You know, I was told at the beginning of this whole undertaking that there are two lanes, a progressive lane that Bernie Sanders is the incumbent for and a moderate lane
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在整个竞选开始时，有人告诉我这里有两条赛道，一条是伯尼·桑德斯作为在任者所在的进步派赛道，另一条是

sentences.en: that Joe Biden is the incumbent for, and there's no room for anyone else in this.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登作为在任者所在的温和派赛道，而且这里容不下其他人。

sentences.en: I thought that wasn't right, but evidently, I was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我曾认为那不对，但显然，我错了。

sentences.en: Warren declined to endorse either Biden or Sanders for now, and during a news conference in front of her house, expressed regret that there was no longer a woman in the race.
sentences.zh: 沃伦目前拒绝背书拜登或桑德斯，并在她家门前举行的新闻发布会上，对竞选舞台上不再有女性候选人表达了遗憾。

sentences.en: And I wonder what your message would be to the women and girls who feel like we're left with two white men to decide between.
sentences.zh: 我想问，你对那些觉得只剩下两名白人男性可供抉择的女性和女孩们有什么话要说？

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我懂。

sentences.en: One of the hardest parts of this
sentences.zh: 其中最艰难的部分之一

sentences.en: is all those big promises and all those little girls who are going to have to wait four more years.
sentences.zh: 就是所有那些宏大的承诺，以及所有那些还要再等四年的小女孩们。

sentences.en: That's going to be hard.
sentences.zh: 这会很难受。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会喝到断片来睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
